source: CED Engineering S02-048 — Calculating Wind Loads on Buildings Using the Envelope Procedure of ASCE 7-22 Code
description: Low-rise commercial/warehouse metal building, gable roof at 18.4 degrees, Exposure C, flat terrain, enclosed
extracted_by: Claude Opus 4.7 via pdftotext from S02-048 PDF
limitations: Source has internal inconsistency: Step 2 cites V=116 mph (from ASCE 7 Hazard Tool), but Step 5 uses V=115 mph in the qh calculation. Final pressures are computed with V=115. Using V=115 here to match the final-pressure math.

GCpf table values (Tables 3 and 4 in source) did NOT extract from PDF — they are image-based. Only one Surface 1 worked-out p value (+10.0 / +20.6 psf) is in the text. Full GCpf surface-by-surface table needs to be transcribed visually from the PDF before this case is complete.
CED is continuing-ed course material, not ASCE-published. Treat as informational, not authoritative.

expected_intermediates.qh_formula_per_source_ced: CED uses qh = 0.00256 * Kh * Kzt * Ke * V^2  (CED claims Kd moved to p in 7-22 — INCORRECT per book page 277)
expected_intermediates.qh_formula_per_asce_7_22: qh = 0.00256 * Kz * Kzt * Ke * Kd * V^2  (book page 277 Eq. 26.10-1, Kd IS in qh — verified 2026-06-13)
expected_intermediates.kd_placement_resolution: Engine matches ASCE 7-22 book. CED is wrong about formula. Compare engine FINAL pressures to CED, NOT engine qh to CED qh.

load_case_1_surface_1.formula_per_source: p = qh * Kd * (GCpf - GCpi)  where qh=34.6, Kd=0.85

expected_final_pressures.other_surfaces_load_case_1: NOT EXTRACTED — see limitations. Need to read PDF figure tables visually.
expected_final_pressures.load_case_3_torsional: Zone T pressures = 25% of full design pressures (per source). Specific values NOT EXTRACTED.

engine_comparison_notes.kd_placement_resolution_2026_06_13: VERIFIED against ASCE 7-22 book page 277. Eq. 26.10-1 has Kd INSIDE qz. Engine is CORRECT. CED PDF was wrong about a formula change.
engine_comparison_notes.final_p_check: Engine should produce p = 20.6 psf for Surface 1 Load Case 1 with negative GCpi. Same as CED. Use this as the primary comparison target.
engine_comparison_notes.intermediate_qh_warning: Engine's qh = 29.4 psf (correct per 7-22). CED's qh = 34.6 psf (their non-standard removal of Kd). Do NOT flag this difference as a bug — they are different quantities.
engine_comparison_notes.harness_comparison_target: Use FINAL DESIGN PRESSURE p only when comparing engine output to CED. Skip qh comparison.
